Ta phai bien dao no thanh dang tuong thuoc truoc khi ap dung he thuc Viet. Ban nen nhan hai v\u00f4i $x$ (voi $x \\ne 0$) va da chuyen ve phep nhan th\u00e2n.",

      "cue": "He thuc Viet: $x_1+x_2 = -b/a$, $x_1x_2 = c/a$",
      "explanation": "Soi phuong trinh $x^2 - 4x + 2 = 0$, ta co $a=1, b=-4, c=2$. N\u00ean $x_1 + x_2 = -(-4)/1 = 4$ va $x_1x_2 = 2/1 = 2$.",

      "question": "Bieu thuc can tim la $\\frac{x_1}{x_2} + \\frac{x_2}{x_1}$. Ban nen rong m\u00e3i hai ph\u00e2n so nay chung m\u00e3i sau do r\u1ed3i thu g\u1ecdn, sau khi dat $x_1+x_2$ va $x_1x_2$ vao.",
      "cue": "Rong m\u00e3i ph\u00e2n so: $\\frac{a}{b} + \\frac{b}{a} = \\frac{a^2+b^2}{ab} = \\frac{(a+b)^2-2ab}{ab}$",
